remarks: Beautifully renovated 2 bedroom, 1.5 bath townhouse in the sought after Silvermine area of Norwalk. This move in ready home features a brand new kitchen and new hardwood flooring throughout, along with thoughtful upgrades including custom tilework in the entry, custom shiplap accents, and elegant French doors on the bedroom closets. The spacious main level offers an open living and dining area with a wood burning fireplace and sliders leading to a private patio that backs up to a peaceful preserve. The kitchen includes a sun filled breakfast nook with atrium style windows. The main floor also includes a powder room, coat closet, and additional storage. Upstairs you will find a large primary bedroom with multiple closets, a second bedroom with a walk in closet, convenient upstairs laundry, and a Jack and Jill full bath. Why do the work when you can just move in. Quiet location yet close to major highways, shopping, and restaurants. Reach out today to schedule your private showing!
